title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: A cloud layer is overhead, from between about 6,600 and 6,900 ft to the summit or above (Park HQ, Nene Nest and Summit in it, Kamehamenui 1 below). First clouds will form at about 3,800 ft; the slope is drying as it warms. Today's forecast: Thermals probably flat. Trades from the NE should put the shear line crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio. Upslope has not set in yet.
